updates.note: Management reaffirmed the sustainable long-term EBITDA margin trend of around 26% to 27%.
Repair and overhaul growth rate from next year onwards is expected to be at around 5% to 6%.
updates.quote: from the next year onwards, the growth in the repair and overhaul will be at around 5% to 6%.

updates.note: Cash balance target as of 31st March 2023 was not mentioned on this call.
Management confirmed that 3 aircraft are scheduled for delivery in the current financial year for LCA Mk1A.
updates.quote: In the current financial year, we are supposed to deliver 1 fighter and 2 trainer, total 3 aircraft during the current financial year.

new_promises.statement: Achieve double-digit revenue growth of 10% from FY25 onwards.
new_promises.quote: we will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect revenue growth to stabilize around 14% to 15% after FY25.
new_promises.quote: we expect the growth at around 12% to 13% and then stabilize at around 14% to 15%.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Conclude estimated order value of INR 48,000 crores in the coming 6 to 10 months.
new_promises.quote: we expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year, which means within a time span of 6 to 10 months.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
